title: Rack-4 cooling fault — ambient rising across all nodes
summary: The vertiv CRAC Supply_Air_Temperature feeding rack 4 climbed from ~18°C to ~30°C, and IPMI ambient (inlet) on every rack-4 node (r4n0–r4n7) rose from ~22°C to ~32°C over 2 hours — a rack-wide signature of a cooling (CRAC) fault rather than a single-node issue. Fans ramped up.
notes: Check the cooling unit serving rack 4; ambient rising on ALL nodes rules out per-node fault.
